author: reek
body: This is pinned because three published compliance rows leaned on it and two of them were false in the same direction. The CRA matrix described an effect-typed Audit channel and a TLS channel requiring a Crypto effect row; neither capability exists, so neither effect row can be written, and both rows described mechanisms no program could express. CDX4001 is what says so, and until now nothing required it: two tests mention the code in their prose and no sidecar had ever demanded it, which is the condition under which a refusal quietly stops happening.

author: reek
body: Audit is the name used here deliberately, because it is the one a reader is most likely to assume exists.
